title: Pramuka nyang meubulu
intro: Lam saboh keurajeuen nyang geumat lé sidroe ureueng nyang geubri keukuasaan ateuh angen, makhlok-makhlok nyang hana deuh, ngon makhluk-makhluk langet, sidroe anggota ubeut ngon bagah that gadeh nibak barisan-hanya keu geuwoe ngon wahyu nyang akan geubentuk lom nasib saboh nanggroe nyang jioh. Informan nyang mata jih tajam nyoe geuba kebenaran keu trang dipat keubodohan ka meu-ukheue. Soe Lon?
clues: Lon meutugaih bak saboh istana dipat manusia, makhlok-makhlok gaib, dan makhlok-makhlok langet geujaweueb keu sidroe peunguasa nyang bijaksana nyang geupeurintah angen-angen nyang that-that.
Lon absen bak jabatan lon keu siat, dan beungeh penguasa ka geujanjikan meunyo lon hana lon bri alasan nyang memuaskan.
Lon nakeuh makhlok ubeut nyang jiplueng, jituri ngon pandangan nyang tajam, dan jeuneh lon jihoreumat ngon nan langsong lam halaman-halaman wahyu.
Watèë ulôn woë, ulôn ba haba nanggroë njang djeuôh disinan ureuëng-ureuëng njan djisujud keu mata uroë, buta keu njang peugot langèt dan bumoë.
Ulôn meurumpok ngon sidroe ureuëng inong nyang mat peurintah ateueh saboh keurajeuen nyang rayeuk, nyang teungoh jiduek ateueh takhta nyang meugah, nyang hana tom jiteupeue keubeunaran sigohlom jih.
Lon nakeuh nyang teumeung ranah Saba’ dan nyang ba surat undangan dari sidroe nabi-raja nyang geubri kuasa ateuh angen.

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Bilqis teuka lam tundok keu mahkamah Sulaiman .
Firaun ngon tantra gobnyan karam lam laôt .
Ureuëng 'Ad hancô lé angèn nyang teuga .
Tukang sihe Fir'un peucaya keu Nabi Musa
Ié raya nyang peuhabéh ureuëng kaphé .
outcome.answer: Bilqis teuka lam tundok keu mahkamah Sulaiman .

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
